name: Vivacious Rose Prism Ioun Stone
source: Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 39
body:
Source Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 39
Aura strong varied CL 12th
Slot none; Price —; Weight —
Description
While in use, a vivacious rose prism ioun stone grants a +2 insight bonus to AC.
Destruction
This stone can be destroyed like any other ioun stone, except it has AC 26, 50 hit points, and hardness 10.
